name: How long does a typical caulking repair project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical caulking repair project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a caulking repair project depends on its size and complexity. For a small area, such as a single bathroom or a few windows, the work might be completed within a few hours. Larger projects, like recaulking all exterior windows and doors of a house or extensive interior areas, could take one to several days. Factors like existing caulk removal, surface preparation, and the drying time of the new caulk also influence the overall timeline. Your contractor can provide a more precise estimate after assessing the job.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by size; small jobs may take hours, while larger projects can take one to several days, depending on scope and drying time.
